Não. Hoje `source_mode="youtube_background"` **não é o default**. O default atual no pipeline é `manual` em [audio_pipeline.py](C:/Users/acaci/Documents/scoreIA/ScoreIA/tools/audio_gen/audio_pipeline.py).

Sim: o que estamos mirando é **YouTube-only + reprodução em background + captura via loopback + device dedicado/virtual**. Nesse desenho, você pode continuar ouvindo outra coisa no device principal, **desde que** o YouTube em background esteja roteado para o `VB-CABLE` e a sua música principal fique no seu device normal. Se os dois usarem o mesmo device, eles se misturam.

`mpv` **não** é o device virtual. `mpv` é um player de mídia. A documentação oficial o descreve como “a media player based on MPlayer and mplayer2”. Fontes:
- [mpv overview](https://mpv.io/)
- [mpv manual](https://mpv.io/manual/stable/)
- [mpv installation](https://mpv.io/installation/)

O resto, de forma direta:
- `yt-dlp`: ferramenta open source para resolver/extrair URLs reproduzíveis de sites como YouTube. Fonte: [yt-dlp Installation](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Installation)
- `YouTubeDL`: é a classe Python do pacote `yt_dlp` usada programaticamente
- `VB-CABLE`: driver de áudio virtual; o áudio que entra no `CABLE Input` sai no `CABLE Output`. Fonte: [VB-CABLE oficial](https://vb-audio.com/Cable/)

**Setup mínimo**
1. Instalar `yt-dlp` na `.venv310`:
```powershell
.\.venv310\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install yt-dlp
```

2. Instalar `mpv`:
- caminho oficial da documentação do mpv para Windows…622 chars truncated… devices no ScoreIA:
```powershell
.\.venv310\Scripts\python.exe -c "from tools.audio_gen.audio_pipeline import list_available_audio_routing_devices; import json; print(json.dumps(list_available_audio_routing_devices(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))"
```

7. Validar devices no mpv:
```powershell
mpv --audio-device=help
```

**Passo a passo para “levantar um mpv local”**
Sem custo: sim.  
Sem internet: só **depois de instalado**. Para instalar, você precisa baixar o binário uma vez. E para tocar **YouTube**, vai continuar precisando de internet sempre.

Fluxo mínimo do `mpv` local:
1. baixar e extrair `mpv`
2. garantir `mpv.exe` no `PATH`
3. testar com arquivo local offline:
```powershell
mpv --no-video "C:\caminho\arquivo.mp3"
```

Para tocar em background:
```powershell
mpv --no-video --force-window=no "C:\caminho\arquivo.mp3"
```

Para tocar no device escolhido:
```powershell
mpv --audio-device=help
mpv --no-video --force-window=no --audio-device="NOME_DO_DEVICE_DO_MPV" "C:\caminho\arquivo.mp3"
```

**Realidade importante**
- `mpv local sem internet`: sim, para arquivos locais
- `YouTube em background sem internet`: não
- `YouTube em background sem abrir seu browser principal`: sim, esse é exatamente o caminho que estamos montando

**Próximo passo recomendado**
1. instalar `yt-dlp`
2. instalar `mpv`
3. instalar `VB-CABLE`
4. me mandar a saída de:
```powershell
mpv --audio-device=help
```

Com isso eu consigo te passar o comando exato do `youtube_background` para o seu setup.

O que seria um "motivo"?

Na música, um `motivo` é uma **pequena ideia musical reconhecível** que se repete ou varia ao longo da faixa.

Pode ser, por exemplo:
- uma sequência curta de notas
- um desenho rítmico marcante
- uma combinação de ritmo + melodia

É menor que uma melodia completa. Pense nele como um “bloco de identidade” da música.

Exemplo simples:
- 3 ou 4 notas que aparecem várias vezes
- um padrão curto de piano
- um riff pequeno de synth
- um desenho de baixo que volta em pontos diferentes

No contexto do ScoreIA, usar um motivo significa:
- não gerar notas totalmente aleatórias o tempo todo
- criar uma célula musical curta
- repetir, deslocar, inverter, simplificar ou ornamentar essa célula
- assim o beat ganha unidade e memória, em vez de soar solto

Então:
- `caos`: nas variações
- `padrão melódico`: no motivo base

Em termos práticos, hoje ele decide assim:

- **Base estrutural**: o renderer parte do blueprint ativo do projeto.
- **Quantidade de camadas**:
  - se o blueprint já vier com camadas recomendadas, ele usa isso;
  - se faltar baixo, ele adiciona `bass`;
  - se faltar camada melódica, ele adiciona `melody`;
  - se houver referência de áudio, pode adicionar `texture` e `chop`.
- **Complexidade do arranjo**:
  - poucas barras => arranjo simples;
  - mais barras => `intro`, `main_a`, `fill`, `main_b`, `outro` em [audio_pipeline.py](C:/Users/acaci/Documents/scoreIA/ScoreIA/tools/audio_gen/audio_pipeline.py:464)
- **Complexidade interna das patterns**:
  - cresce com `creativity`
  - cresce com `fill_probability`
  - varia por papel (`kick`, `snare`, `hat`, `bass`, etc.)
- **Complexidade tonal/melódica**:
  - hoje vem do `pitch_context` inferido da referência ou do contexto tonal disponível em [audio_pipeline.py](C:/Users/acaci/Documents/scoreIA/ScoreIA/tools/audio_gen/audio_pipeline.py:551)
  - a `bassline` e o `motivo` usam regras programadas, não uma composição aprendida em larga escala, em [audio_pipeline.py](C:/Users/acaci/Documents/scoreIA/ScoreIA/tools/audio_gen/audio_pipeline.py:669)

- **com URL/reference de YouTube**:
  - entra mais contexto;
  - podem surgir `texture` e `chop`;
  - o timbre e a direção tonal ficam mais ricos.
- **sem URL/reference**:

A melhor regra, hoje, é esta:

**No webapp em produção:**
- `vocal-fit` deve rodar **sem transcrição por padrão**

**Regra recomendada**
Use transcrição apenas quando:
- o runtime de transcrição estiver realmente saudável
- o custo/latência estiver aceitável
- e houver ganho claro para aquele caso

Na prática, eu usaria esta política:

1. `default = sem transcrição`
- mais rápido
- mais previsível
- suficiente para a maior parte do `vocal-fit` atual

2. `ligar transcrição só se tudo abaixo for verdadeiro`
- `enable_vocal_transcription` foi ativado internamente pelo backend
- `runtime_env.capabilities.transcription == true`
- modelo compatível
- e o contexto do job justificar o custo

3. `desligar automaticamente` se:
- o runtime marcar transcrição como indisponível
- houver fallback para CPU muito caro
- o job já estiver pesado demais
- ou o áudio for longo demais para a SLA desejada

Por que há duplicidade na criação de pastas entre project/ e artifacts/ ?

Porque hoje o sistema separa **estado do projeto** de **saídas de execução**.

A ideia arquitetural é esta:

- `projects/audio_gen/...`
  - é a base persistente do projeto
  - guarda manifests e assets “oficiais” do projeto
  - é onde ficam coisas como:
    - `project.json`
    - referências promovidas
    - working sets
    - blueprints
    - manifests de mix/master/capture

- `artifacts/audio_gen/...`
  - é a área de execução
  - guarda outputs de runs específicos
  - é onde ficam:
    - arquivos temporários/intermediários
    - renderizações por run
    - transcripts por run
    - mixes/masters gerados numa execução específica
    - manifests técnicos daquele run

Então não era para ser “duplicidade sem sentido”; era para ser uma separação entre:
- `fonte de verdade do projeto`
- `rastros e outputs operacionais de cada execução`

**Por que isso faz sentido**
Porque um mesmo projeto pode ter várias execuções:
- tentativa A
- tentativa B
- outro vocal
- outro beat
- outro mix

def _build_arrangement_sections(total_bars: int) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    def _section(
        name: str,
        bars: int,
        *,
        energy: float,
        drum_density: float,
        melodic_density: float,
        chop_density: float,
        bass_density: float,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": name,
            "bars": int(max(1, bars)),
            "energy": float(energy),
            "drum_density": float(drum_density),
            "melodic_density": float(melodic_density),
            "chop_density": float(chop_density),
            "bass_density": float(bass_density),
        }

    total_bars = max(1, int(total_bars))
    if total_bars <= 4:
        return [_section("main_a", total_bars, energy=0.92, drum_density=0.92, melodic_density=0.9, chop_density=0.82, bass_density=0.96)]
    if total_bars <= 8:
        intro_bars = 1
        outro_bars = 1
        main_a_bars = max(2, total_bars - intro_bars - outro_bars)
        return [
            _section("intro", intro_bars, energy=0.62, drum_density=0.55, melodic_density=0.5, chop_density=0.42, bass_density=0.74),
            _section("main_a", main_a_bars, energy=0.94, drum_density=0.92, melodic_density=0.9, chop_density=0.88, bass_density=0.98),
            _section("outro", outro_bars, energy=0.54, drum_density=0.48, melodic_density=0.46, chop_density=0.36, bass_density=0.66),
        ]

    if total_bars >= 24:
        intro_bars = 4
        fill_bars = 1
        break_bars = 2
        outro_bars = 2
        remaining = total_bars - intro_bars - fill_bars - break_bars - outro_bars
        main_a_bars = max(6, int(round(remaining * 0.37)))
        main_b_bars = max(5, int(round(remaining * 0.32)))
        main_c_bars = max(4, remaining - main_a_bars - main_b_bars)
        overflow = intro_bars + main_a_bars + fill_bars + main_b_bars + break_bars + main_c_bars + outro_bars - total_bars
        if overflow > 0:
            main_a_bars = max(6, main_a_bars - overflow)
            main_c_bars = max(4, total_bars - intro_bars - main_a_bars - fill_bars - main_b_bars - break_bars - outro_bars)
        return [
            _section("intro", intro_bars, energy=0.6, drum_density=0.52, melodic_density=0.46, chop_density=0.38, bass_density=0.72),
            _section("main_a", main_a_bars, energy=0.88, drum_density=0.84, melodic_density=0.8, chop_density=0.74, bass_density=0.94),
            _section("fill", fill_bars, energy=1.08, drum_density=1.18, melodic_density=0.68, chop_density=1.06, bass_density=0.84),
            _section("main_b", main_b_bars, energy=1.0, drum_density=1.02, melodic_density=0.96, chop_density=0.98, bass_density=1.0),
            _section("break", break_bars, energy=0.54, drum_density=0.44, melodic_density=0.36, chop_density=0.52, bass_density=0.62),
            _section("main_c", main_c_bars, energy=1.06, drum_density=1.08, melodic_density=1.04, chop_density=1.1, bass_density=1.02),
            _section("outro", outro_bars, energy=0.5, drum_density=0.42, melodic_density=0.34, chop_density=0.3, bass_density=0.58),
        ]

    intro_bars = 2
    outro_bars = 1
    fill_bars = 1
    remaining = total_bars - intro_bars - outro_bars - fill_bars
    main_a_bars = max(3, int(math.ceil(remaining * 0.5)))
    main_b_bars = max(2, remaining - main_a_bars)
    overflow = intro_bars + outro_bars + fill_bars + main_a_bars + main_b_bars - total_bars
    if overflow > 0:
        main_a_bars = max(2, main_a_bars - overflow)

    return [
        _section("intro", intro_bars, energy=0.68, drum_density=0.6, melodic_density=0.56, chop_density=0.45, bass_density=0.78),
        _section("main_a", main_a_bars, energy=0.94, drum_density=0.9, melodic_density=0.88, chop_density=0.84, bass_density=0.98),
        _section("fill", fill_bars, energy=1.08, drum_density=1.16, melodic_density=0.72, chop_density=1.08, bass_density=0.86),
        _section("main_b", main_b_bars, energy=1.02, drum_density=1.04, melodic_density=1.0, chop_density=1.02, bass_density=1.0),
        _section("outro", outro_bars, energy=0.56, drum_density=0.5, melodic_density=0.48, chop_density=0.38, bass_density=0.68),
    ]


def _midi_to_frequency(midi_note: float) -> float:
    return float(440.0 * (2.0 ** ((float(midi_note) - 69.0) / 12.0)))


def _frequency_to_midi(frequency_hz: float) -> float:
    return float(69.0 + (12.0 * math.log2(max(float(frequency_hz), 1e-6) / 440.0)))


def _key_name_to_pitch_class(key_name: str) -> Optional[int]:
    normalized = _clean_text(key_name).upper().replace("â™¯", "#").replace("â™­", "B")
    mapping = {
        "C": 0,
        "C#": 1,
        "DB": 1,
        "D": 2,
        "D#": 3,
        "EB": 3,
        "E": 4,
        "F": 5,
        "F#": 6,
        "GB": 6,
        "G": 7,
        "G#": 8,
        "AB": 8,
        "A": 9,
        "A#": 10,
        "BB": 10,
        "B": 11,
    }
    return mapping.get(normalized)


def _pitch_class_to_key_name(pitch_class: Optional[int]) -> Optional[str]:
    if pitch_class is None:
        return None
    mapping = {
        0: "C",
        1: "C#",
        2: "D",
        3: "D#",
        4: "E",
        5: "F",
        6: "F#",
        7: "G",
        8: "G#",
        9: "A",
        10: "A#",
        11: "B",
    }
    return mapping.get(int(pitch_class) % 12)


def _transpose_key_name(key_name: Optional[str], semitone_shift: int) -> Optional[str]:
    pitch_class = _key_name_to_pitch_class(key_name or "")
    if pitch_class is None:
        return None
    return _pitch_class_to_key_name(int(pitch_class) + int(semitone_shift))


def _scale_intervals(scale_name: str) -> List[int]:
    normalized = _clean_text(scale_name).lower()
    if normalized in {"minor", "aeolian", "dorian", "phrygian"}:
        return [0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10]
    return [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11]


def _nearest_scale_midi(target_midi: float, root_pitch_class: int, scale_intervals: List[int]) -> int:
    base = int(round(target_midi))
    best_candidate = base
    best_distance = float("inf")
    for candidate in range(base - 24, base + 25):
        pitch_class = candidate % 12
        if ((pitch_class - root_pitch_class) % 12) not in scale_intervals:
            continue
        distance = abs(candidate - target_midi)
        if distance < best_distance:
            best_distance = distance
            best_candidate = candidate
    return int(best_candidate)


def _extract_reference_pitch_context(blueprint: Dict[str, Any], sub_frequency_hz: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    render_overrides = dict(blueprint.get("_render_overrides") or {})
    key_name = ""
    scale_name = ""
    key_confidence = None
    source_path = ""
    anchor_locked = False
    for summary in blueprint.get("reference_summaries") or []:
        analysis = summary.get("analysis") or {}
        key_name = _clean_text(analysis.get("estimated_key"))
        scale_name = _clean_text(analysis.get("estimated_scale"))
        key_confidence = analysis.get("estimated_key_confidence")
        source_path = _clean_text(summary.get("path"))
        if key_name:
            break

    override_key_name = _clean_text(render_overrides.get("tonal_anchor_key"))
    override_scale_name = _clean_text(render_overrides.get("tonal_anchor_scale"))
    override_confidence = render_overrides.get("tonal_anchor_confidence")
    if override_key_name:
        key_name = override_key_name
        source_path = _clean_text(render_overrides.get("tonal_anchor_source")) or source_path
        anchor_locked = True
    if override_scale_name:
        scale_name = override_scale_name
        anchor_locked = True
    if override_confidence is not None:
        key_confidence = override_confidence

    try:
        normalized_confidence = float(key_confidence) if key_confidence is not None else None
    except Exception:
        normalized_confidence = None

    if (
        not anchor_locked
        and source_path
        and os.path.exists(source_path)
        and (not key_name or normalized_confidence is None or normalized_confidence < 0.1)
    ):
        refreshed = _compute_librosa_descriptors(source_path, sample_rate=22050)
        if refreshed:
            refreshed_key = _clean_text(refreshed.get("estimated_key"))
            refreshed_scale = _clean_text(refreshed.get("estimated_scale"))
            refreshed_confidence = refreshed.get("estimated_key_confidence")
            if refreshed_key:
                key_name = refreshed_key
            if refreshed_scale:
                scale_name = refreshed_scale
            try:
                normalized_confidence = float(refreshed_confidence) if refreshed_confidence is not None else normalized_confidence
            except Exception:
                pass

    style_tags = {tag.lower() for tag in _normalize_str_list(blueprint.get("style_tags"))}
    if not scale_name:
        scale_name = "minor" if any(token in style_tags for token in ("dark", "boom bap", "old school", "sub-heavy")) else "major"

    root_pitch_class = _key_name_to_pitch_class(key_name)
    if root_pitch_class is None:
        root_pitch_class = int(round(_frequency_to_midi(max(sub_frequency_hz, 55.0)))) % 12

    scale_intervals = _scale_intervals(scale_name)
    bass_root_midi = _nearest_scale_midi(_frequency_to_midi(max(sub_frequency_hz, 50.0)), root_pitch_class, scale_intervals)
    if bass_root_midi < 34:
        bass_root_midi += 12
    elif bass_root_midi > 48:
        bass_root_midi -= 12

    melody_root_midi = _nearest_scale_midi(bass_root_midi + 24, root_pitch_class, scale_intervals)
    if scale_name.lower() == "minor":
        if any(token in style_tags for token in ("dark", "boom bap", "old school", "griselda", "wu tang")):
            section_progressions = {
                "intro": [0, 5],
                "main_a": [0, 5, 3, 4],
                "fill": [4, 5],
                "break": [5, 3],
                "main_b": [0, 3, 5, 4],
                "main_c": [0, 6, 5, 4],
                "outro": [0, 5],
            }
        else:
            section_progressions = {
                "intro": [0, 3],
                "main_a": [0, 3, 5, 4],
                "fill": [5, 4],
                "break": [3, 5],
                "main_b": [0, 5, 3, 4],
                "main_c": [0, 4, 5, 3],
                "outro": [0, 3],
            }
    else:
        section_progressions = {
            "intro": [0, 4],
            "main_a": [0, 4, 5, 3],
            "fill": [5, 4],
            "break": [4, 5],
            "main_b": [0, 5, 4, 3],
            "main_c": [0, 3, 4, 5],
            "outro": [0, 4],
        }
    return {
        "estimated_key": key_name or None,
        "estimated_scale": scale_name,
        "estimated_key_confidence": round(float(normalized_confidence), 4) if normalized_confidence is not None else None,
        "anchor_locked": bool(anchor_locked),
        "root_pitch_class": int(root_pitch_class),
        "scale_intervals": scale_intervals,
        "bass_root_midi": int(bass_root_midi),
        "melody_root_midi": int(melody_root_midi),
        "section_progressions": section_progressions,
        "source_path": source_path or None,
    }


def _add_synth_note(
    buffer: "np.ndarray",
    sample_rate: int,
    start_seconds: float,
    duration_seconds: float,
    frequency_hz: float,
    amplitude: float,
    role: str,
) -> None:
    if np is None:
        raise RuntimeError("NumPy nao esta disponivel no runtime atual.")
    start_index = int(round(max(0.0, start_seconds) * sample_rate))
    length = max(32, int(round(max(0.03, duration_seconds) * sample_rate)))
    end_index = min(buffer.shape[0], start_index + length)
    if end_index <= start_index:
        return

    t = np.arange(end_index - start_index, dtype=np.float32) / float(sample_rate)
    role_name = (_clean_text(role) or "melody").lower()
    if role_name == "bass":
        body = np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * t)
        overtone = 0.24 * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * 2.0 * t + 0.25)
        grit = 0.08 * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * 3.0 * t + 0.18)
        signal_mono = np.tanh((body + overtone + grit) * 1.18)
        attack = 0.008
        release = 0.18
    else:
        body = np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * t)
        shimmer = 0.22 * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * 2.0 * t)
        air = 0.1 * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * 3.0 * t + 0.4)
        body2 = 0.06 * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * 4.0 * t + 0.2)
        signal_mono = np.tanh((body + shimmer + air + body2) * 1.1)
        attack = 0.015
        release = 0.16

    env = np.ones_like(t, dtype=np.float32)
    attack_len = min(len(env), max(1, int(round(attack * sample_rate))))
    env[:attack_len] *= np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, attack_len, dtype=np.float32)
    release_len = min(len(env), max(1, int(round(release * sample_rate))))
    env[-release_len:] *= np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, release_len, dtype=np.float32)
    sustain_curve = np.exp(-t * (2.4 if role_name == "bass" else 3.25))
    mono = signal_mono * env * sustain_curve * float(amplitude)
    stereo = _stereo_from_mono(mono)
    buffer[start_index:end_index] += stereo[: end_index - start_index]


def _build_phrase_note_events(
    role: str,
    sections: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    tempo_bpm: float,
    steps_per_bar: int,
    pitch_context: Dict[str, Any],
    creativity: float,
    seed: int,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    resolved_role = (_clean_text(role) or "melody").lower()
    scale_intervals = list(pitch_context["scale_intervals"])
    bass_root = int(pitch_context["bass_root_midi"])
    melody_root = int(pitch_context["melody_root_midi"])
    section_progressions = dict(pitch_context.get("section_progressions") or {})
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    seconds_per_bar = 240.0 / float(tempo_bpm)
    step_seconds = seconds_per_bar / float(steps_per_bar)

    bass_walk_degrees = [0, 2, 4, 3, 0, 5, 4, 2]
    motif_steps = [0, 3, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14]
    events: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    current_bar_start = 0.0

    for section_index, section in enumerate(sections):
        section_name = _clean_text(section.get("name")) or f"section_{section_index + 1}"
        bars = max(1, int(section.get("bars") or 1))
        progression = list(section_progressions.get(section_name) or section_progressions.get("main_a") or [0])
        bass_density = float(section.get("bass_density") or 1.0)
        melodic_density = float(section.get("melodic_density") or 1.0)

        for bar_index in range(bars):
            progression_degree = int(progression[bar_index % len(progression)]) if progression else 0
            progression_offset = scale_intervals[progression_degree % len(scale_intervals)]
            if resolved_role == "bass":
                step_candidates = {
                    "intro": [0],
                    "main_a": [0, 8],
                    "fill": [0, 6, 10, 12],
                    "main_b": [0, 4, 8, 12],
                    "break": [0],
                    "main_c": [0, 4, 8, 11, 14],
                    "outro": [0],
                }.get(section_name, [0, 8])
                for event_index, step in enumerate(step_candidates):
                    degree = bass_walk_degrees[(bar_index + event_index) % len(bass_walk_degrees)]
                    midi_note = bass_root + progression_offset + scale_intervals[degree % len(scale_intervals)]
                    if section_name == "fill" and event_index >= 2:
                        midi_note += 12
                    if section_name == "main_b" and event_index == len(step_candidates) - 1 and rng.random() < 0.45:
                        midi_note += 12
                    if section_name == "main_c" and event_index in {1, 3} and rng.random() < 0.42:
                        midi_note += 12
                    duration_steps = 5 if step == 0 else 3 if section_name != "main_b" else 2
                    if section_name == "main_c" and step != 0:
                        duration_steps = 2
                    amplitude = (0.46 if step == 0 else 0.34) * bass_density
                    if rng.random() < creativity * 0.22:
                        midi_note += 12 if rng.random() < 0.25 else 0
                    events.append(
                        {
                            "start_seconds": round(float(current_bar_start + (step * step_seconds)), 4),
                            "duration_seconds": round(float(duration_steps * step_seconds), 4),
                            "frequency_hz": round(_midi_to_frequency(midi_note), 3),
                            "amplitude": round(float(amplitude), 4),
                            "midi_note": int(midi_note),
                            "section_name": section_name,
                        }
                    )
            else:
                active_steps = {
                    "intro": [8, 12],
                    "main_a": [0, 4, 8, 12],
                    "fill": [8, 10, 12, 14],
                    "main_b": [0, 3, 6, 8, 11, 14],
                    "break": [10],
                    "main_c": [0, 2, 4, 7, 9, 12, 14],
                    "outro": [0, 6],
                }.get(section_name, [0, 4, 8, 12])
                motif_pool = {
                    "intro": [0, 2, 4, 2, 0, 4],
                    "main_a": [0, 2, 4, 2, 0, 5, 4, 2],
                    "fill": [4, 5, 6, 5, 4, 2],
                    "main_b": [0, 4, 5, 7, 4, 2, 5, 4],
                    "break": [4, 2, 0],
                    "main_c": [0, 4, 7, 5, 4, 2, 7, 5],
                    "outro": [0, 2, 4, 2, 0, 2],
                }.get(section_name, [0, 2, 4, 2, 0, 5, 4, 2])
                for event_index, step in enumerate(active_steps):
                    degree = motif_pool[(bar_index * 2 + event_index) % len(motif_pool)]
                    midi_note = melody_root + progression_offset + scale_intervals[degree % len(scale_intervals)]
                    if section_name == "main_b" and event_index % 3 == 0:
                        midi_note += 12
                    if section_name == "fill" and event_index >= 2:
                        midi_note += 12
                    if rng.random() < creativity * 0.16:
                        midi_note += 12 if rng.random() < 0.4 else -12
                    if section_name == "main_a" and event_index == 0 and bar_index % 4 == 3 and rng.random() < 0.35:
                        continue
                    if section_name == "break" and event_index == 0 and rng.random() < 0.4:
                        midi_note -= 12
                    duration_steps = 3 if step in motif_steps else 2
                    if section_name == "main_b" and event_index in {1, 4}:
                        duration_steps = 4
                    if section_name == "main_c" and event_index in {0, 3, 5}:
                        duration_steps = 4
                    amplitude = (0.22 if section_name != "fill" else 0.18) * melodic_density
                    events.append(
                        {
                            "start_seconds": round(float(current_bar_start + (step * step_seconds)), 4),
                            "duration_seconds": round(float(duration_steps * step_seconds), 4),
                            "frequency_hz": round(_midi_to_frequency(midi_note), 3),
                            "amplitude": round(float(amplitude), 4),
                            "midi_note": int(midi_note),
                            "section_name": section_name,
                        }
                    )
            current_bar_start += seconds_per_bar

    return events


def _synthesize_phrase_track(
    role: str,
    output_path: str,
    sample_rate: int,
    tempo_bpm: float,
    sections: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    steps_per_bar: int,
    pitch_context: Dict[str, Any],
    creativity: float,
    seed: int,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    total_bars = sum(max(1, int(section.get("bars") or 1)) for section in sections)
    total_seconds = (240.0 / float(tempo_bpm)) * total_bars
    total_samples = max(64, int(math.ceil(total_seconds * sample_rate)))
    buffer = np.zeros((total_samples, 2), dtype=np.float32)
    note_events = _build_phrase_note_events(
        role=role,
        sections=sections,
        tempo_bpm=tempo_bpm,
        steps_per_bar=steps_per_bar,
        pitch_context=pitch_context,
        creativity=creativity,
        seed=seed,
    )
    for event in note_events:
        _add_synth_note(
            buffer=buffer,
            sample_rate=sample_rate,
            start_seconds=float(event["start_seconds"]),
            duration_seconds=float(event["duration_seconds"]),
            frequency_hz=float(event["frequency_hz"]),
            amplitude=float(event["amplitude"]),
            role=role,
        )

    stereo = _normalize_audio_buffer(buffer, peak=0.78 if _clean_text(role).lower() == "bass" else 0.62)
    _write_audio_array_to_wav(stereo, output_path, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    return {
        "role": _clean_text(role).lower(),
        "output_path": output_path,
        "duration_seconds": round(float(total_seconds), 4),
        "peak": round(float(np.max(np.abs(stereo))) if stereo.size else 0.0, 6),
        "note_events_count": len(note_events),
        "note_events_preview": note_events[:8],
        "render_mode": "phrase_track",
        "pitch_context": {
            "estimated_key": pitch_context.get("estimated_key"),
            "estimated_scale": pitch_context.get("estimated_scale"),
            "bass_root_midi": pitch_context.get("bass_root_midi"),
            "melody_root_midi": pitch_context.get("melody_root_midi"),
        },
    }


def _build_single_trigger_pattern(total_bars: int, steps_per_bar: int) -> str:
    total_steps = max(1, int(total_bars)) * max(1, int(steps_per_bar))
    return "x" + ("-" * max(0, total_steps - 1))


def _extract_reference_texture_track(
    reference_path: str,
    output_path: str,
    sample_rate: int,
    tempo_bpm: float,
    total_bars: int,
    style_tags: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if np is None:
        raise RuntimeError("NumPy nao esta disponivel no runtime atual.")

    source_path = _resolve_existing_path(reference_path)
    source_audio, _ = _load_audio_array(source_path, sample_rate=sample_rate, channels=DEFAULT_CHANNELS)
    stereo = _ensure_stereo(source_audio)
    total_seconds = (240.0 / float(tempo_bpm)) * max(1, int(total_bars))
    total_samples = max(64, int(math.ceil(total_seconds * sample_rate)))
    seconds_per_bar = 240.0 / float(tempo_bpm)
    segment_seconds = min(max(seconds_per_bar, 1.4), 3.0)
    segment_length = min(stereo.shape[0], max(2048, int(round(segment_seconds * sample_rate))))

    if stereo.shape[0] <= segment_length:
        segment = stereo.copy()
        chosen_start = 0
    else:
        start_min = int(stereo.shape[0] * 0.15)
        start_max = max(start_min + 1, int(stereo.shape[0] * 0.7))
        step = max(512, segment_length // 3)
        best_score = float("-inf")
        chosen_start = start_min
        for start in range(start_min, min(start_max, stereo.shape[0] - segment_length), step):
            window = stereo[start : start + segment_length]
            mono = window.mean(axis=1)
            rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono * mono) + 1e-12))
            if rms < 0.01:
                continue
            brightness = float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(mono)))) if mono.size > 1 else 0.0
            score = (rms * 0.8) + (brightness * 0.2)
            if score > best_score:
                best_score = score
                chosen_start = start
        segment = stereo[chosen_start : chosen_start + segment_length].copy()

    if signal is not None and segment.shape[0] > 128:
        style_tokens = {token.lower() for token in _normalize_str_list(style_tags)}
        lowpass_hz = 4200.0 if "dark" in style_tokens else 6200.0
        try:
            hp_b, hp_a = signal.butter(2, 180.0 / (sample_rate * 0.5), btype="highpass")
            lp_b, lp_a = signal.butter(2, lowpass_hz / (sample_rate * 0.5), btype="lowpass")
            for channel in range(segment.shape[1]):
                filtered = signal.filtfilt(hp_b, hp_a, segment[:, channel]).astype(np.float32)
                filtered = signal.filtfilt(lp_b, lp_a, filtered).astype(np.float32)
                segment[:, channel] = filtered
        except Exception:
            pass

    fade_samples = min(max(64, int(round(sample_rate * 0.03))), max(1, segment.shape[0] // 8))
    fade_in = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, fade_samples, dtype=np.float32)
    fade_out = np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, fade_samples, dtype=np.float32)
    segment[:fade_samples] *= fade_in[:, np.newaxis]
    segment[-fade_samples:] *= fade_out[:, np.newaxis]

    repeats = int(math.ceil(total_samples / max(1, segment.shape[0])))
    tiled = np.tile(segment, (repeats, 1))[:total_samples]
    tiled = _normalize_audio_buffer(tiled * 0.32, peak=0.35)
    _write_audio_array_to_wav(tiled, output_path, sample_rate=sample_rate)
    return {
        "role": "texture",
        "output_path": output_path,
        "duration_seconds": round(float(total_seconds), 4),
        "peak": round(float(np.max(np.abs(tiled))) if tiled.size else 0.0, 6),
        "render_mode": "reference_texture",
        "reference_path": source_path,
        "segment_start_seconds": round(float(chosen_start / float(sample_rate)), 4),
        "segment_duration_seconds": round(float(segment.shape[0] / float(sample_rate)), 4),
    }


def _extract_reference_chop_sample(
    reference_path: str,
    output_path: str,
    sample_rate: int,
    tempo_bpm: float,
    style_tags: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if np is None:
        raise RuntimeError("NumPy nao esta disponivel no runtime atual.")

    source_path = _resolve_existing_path(reference_path)
    source_audio, _ = _load_audio_array(source_path, sample_rate=sample_rate, channels=DEFAULT_CHANNELS)
    stereo = _ensure_stereo(source_audio)
    beat_seconds = 60.0 / max(float(tempo_bpm), 1.0)
    chop_seconds = min(max(beat_seconds * 0.5, 0.18), 0.42)
    chop_samples = min(stereo.shape[0], max(2048, int(round(chop_seconds * sample_rate))))

    if stereo.shape[0] <= chop_samples:
        chosen_start = 0
        chop = stereo.copy()
    else:
        search_start = int(stereo.shape[0] * 0.18)
        search_end = max(search_start + 1, int(stereo.shape[0] * 0.82))
        step = max(512, chop_samples // 2)
        best_score = float("-inf")
        chosen_start = search_start
        for start in range(search_start, min(search_end, stereo.shape[0] - chop_samples), step):
            window = stereo[start : start + chop_samples]
            mono = window.mean(axis=1)
            rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono * mono) + 1e-12))
            attack = float(np.max(np.abs(np.diff(mono)))) if mono.size > 1 else 0.0
            score = (rms * 0.65) + (attack * 0.35)
            if score > best_score:
                best_score = score
                chosen_start = start
        chop = stereo[chosen_start : chosen_start + chop_samples].copy()

        lowpass_hz = 5200.0 if "dark" in style_tokens else 7600.0
        try:
            hp_b, hp_a = signal.butter(2, 220.0 / (sample_rate * 0.5), btype="highpass")
            lp_b, lp_a = signal.butter(2, lowpass_hz / (sample_rate * 0.5), btype="lowpass")
            for channel in range(chop.shape[1]):
                filtered = signal.filtfilt(hp_b, hp_a, chop[:, channel]).astype(np.float32)
                filtered = signal.filtfilt(lp_b, lp_a, filtered).astype(np.float32)
                chop[:, channel] = filtered
        except Exception:
            pass

    fade_samples = min(max(64, int(round(sample_rate * 0.02))), max(1, chop.shape[0] // 6))
    fade_in = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, fade_samples, dtype=np.float32)
    fade_out = np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, fade_samples, dtype=np.float32)
    chop[:fade_samples] *= fade_in[:, np.newaxis]
    chop[-fade_samples:] *= fade_out[:, np.newaxis]

        "render_mode": "reference_chop",
        "reference_path": source_path,
        "segment_start_seconds": round(float(chosen_start / float(sample_rate)), 4),

def _build_reference_chop_pattern(
    sections: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    steps_per_bar: int,
    creativity: float,
    seed: int,
) -> str:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    quarter = max(1, steps_per_bar // 4)
    eighth = max(1, steps_per_bar // 8)
    all_steps: List[bool] = []
    for section in sections:
        section_name = _clean_text(section.get("name")) or "main_a"
        chop_density = float(section.get("chop_density") or 1.0)
        bars = max(1, int(section.get("bars") or 1))
        for bar_index in range(bars):
            steps = [False] * steps_per_bar
            if section_name == "intro":
                for idx in (quarter * 2, steps_per_bar - quarter):
                    if idx < steps_per_bar:
                        steps[idx] = True
            elif section_name == "fill":
                for idx in (quarter * 2, quarter * 2 + max(1, quarter // 2), steps_per_bar - quarter, steps_per_bar - 1):
                    if idx < steps_per_bar:
                        steps[idx] = True
            elif section_name == "outro":
                if quarter * 2 < steps_per_bar:
                    steps[quarter * 2] = True
            elif section_name == "break":
                for idx in (quarter * 2,):
                    if idx < steps_per_bar:
                        steps[idx] = True
            else:
                base_hits = [quarter, quarter * 2 + max(1, quarter // 2), steps_per_bar - quarter]
                for idx in base_hits:
                    if idx < steps_per_bar:
                        steps[idx] = True
                if section_name == "main_a" and rng.random() < (0.24 + (creativity * 0.18)) * chop_density:
                    idx = max(0, quarter * 2 - eighth)
                    if idx < steps_per_bar:
                        steps[idx] = True
                if section_name == "main_b":
                    extra = [max(0, quarter - 1), quarter * 3]
                    for idx in extra:
                        if idx < steps_per_bar and rng.random() < (0.55 + (creativity * 0.25)) * chop_density:
                            steps[idx] = True
                    if rng.random() < (0.34 + (creativity * 0.22)) * chop_density:
                        idx = max(0, steps_per_bar - eighth - 1)
                        if idx < steps_per_bar:
                            steps[idx] = True
                if section_name == "main_c":
                    extra = [max(0, quarter - 1), quarter * 2, quarter * 3, max(0, steps_per_bar - eighth - 1)]
                    for idx in extra:
                        if idx < steps_per_bar and rng.random() < (0.62 + (creativity * 0.22)) * chop_density:
                            steps[idx] = True
                if bar_index % 2 == 1 and rng.random() < 0.22 + (creativity * 0.2):
                    idx = max(0, steps_per_bar - quarter - 1)
                    steps[idx] = True
            all_steps.extend(steps)
    return _pattern_steps_to_text(all_steps)

    status = ensure_runtime_ready("mix")

        f"equalizer=f={7800 if dark_profile else 9200}:t=q:w=0.9:g={0.45 if dark_profile else 0.72}",
        "acompressor=threshold=0.19:ratio=2.35:attack=7:release=135:makeup=1.2",

def _normalize_ffmpeg_filter_path(path: str) -> str:
    normalized = _clean_text(path)
    if not normalized:
        return normalized
    try:
        absolute = os.path.abspath(normalized)
        cwd = os.path.abspath(os.getcwd())
        if os.path.splitdrive(absolute)[0].lower() == os.path.splitdrive(cwd)[0].lower():
            normalized = os.path.relpath(absolute, cwd)
        else:
            normalized = absolute
    except Exception:
        normalized = os.path.abspath(normalized)
    return normalized.replace("\\", "/")


def _run_command(args: List[str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(
        args,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="replace",
        check=False,
    )


def _raise_command_error(command_name: str, result: subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]) -> None:
    stderr = _clean_text(result.stderr)
    stdout = _clean_text(result.stdout)
    message = stderr or stdout or f"Falha ao executar {command_name}."
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def _resolve_run_dir(
    project_id: Optional[str] = None,
    run_id: Optional[str] = None,
    artifacts_root: str = DEFAULT_AUDIO_GEN_ARTIFACTS_DIR,
) -> Dict[str, str]:
    resolved_run_id = _clean_text(run_id) or f"run_{_now_stamp()}"
    if project_id:
        project_dir = build_project_artifact_paths(
            project_id,
            artifacts_root=artifacts_root,
        ).project_artifacts_dir
    else:
        project_dir = os.path.join(artifacts_root, "_ad_hoc")

    run_dir = os.path.join(project_dir, resolved_run_id)
    directories = {
        "project_dir": project_dir,
        "run_id": resolved_run_id,
        "run_dir": run_dir,
        "inputs_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "inputs"),
        "normalized_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "normalized"),
        "transcripts_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "transcripts"),
        "separated_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "separated"),
        "analyses_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "analyses"),
        "beats_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "beats"),
        "mixes_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "mixes"),
        "masters_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "masters"),
        "manifests_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "manifests"),
        "captures_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "captures"),
        "captures_raw_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "captures", "raw"),
        "captures_clean_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, "captures", "clean"),
    }
    for key, directory in directories.items():
        if key.endswith("_dir"):
            os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
    return directories


def _copy_into_directory(source_path: str, target_dir: str) -> str:
    os.makedirs(target_dir, exist_ok=True)
    destination = os.path.join(target_dir, os.path.basename(source_path))
    if os.path.abspath(source_path) != os.path.abspath(destination):
        shutil.copy2(source_path, destination)
    return destination


def _normalize_audio_to_wav(
    source_path: str,
    output_path: str,
    sample_rate: int = DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE,
    channels: int = DEFAULT_CHANNELS,
) -> str:
    ffmpeg_path = ensure_runtime_ready("mix")["ffmpeg_path"]
    result = _run_command(
        [
            ffmpeg_path,
            "-hide_banner",
            "-y",
            "-i",
            source_path,
            "-vn",
            "-ar",
            str(sample_rate),
            "-ac",
            str(channels),
            "-c:a",
            "pcm_s16le",
            output_path,
        ]
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        _raise_command_error("ffmpeg", result)
    return output_path


def _load_wav_array(path: str) -> tuple["np.ndarray", int]:
    if np is None:
        raise RuntimeError("NumPy nao esta disponivel no runtime atual.")

    with wave.open(path, "rb") as handle:
        sample_rate = handle.getframerate()
        channels = handle.getnchannels()
        sample_width = handle.getsampwidth()
        frames = handle.readframes(handle.getnframes())

    if sample_width != 2:
        raise ValueError("A leitura WAV interna espera audio PCM 16-bit.")

    samples = np.frombuffer(frames, dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768.0
    samples = samples.reshape(-1, channels)
    return samples, sample_rate


def _load_audio_array(
    source_path: str,
    sample_rate: int = DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE,
    channels: int = DEFAULT_CHANNELS,
) -> tuple["np.ndarray", int]:
    temporary_wav = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False)
    temporary_wav.close()
    try:
        _normalize_audio_to_wav(
            source_path=source_path,
            output_path=temporary_wav.name,
            sample_rate=sample_rate,
            channels=channels,
        )
        return _load_wav_array(temporary_wav.name)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary_wav.name):
            os.unlink(temporary_wav.name)

) -> str:

def _load_wav_array(path: str) -> tuple["np.ndarray", int]:
    if np is None:
        raise RuntimeError("NumPy nao esta disponivel no runtime atual.")

    with wave.open(path, "rb") as handle:
        sample_rate = handle.getframerate()
        channels = handle.getnchannels()
        sample_width = handle.getsampwidth()
        frames = handle.readframes(handle.getnframes())

    if sample_width != 2:
        raise ValueError("A leitura WAV interna espera audio PCM 16-bit.")

    samples = np.frombuffer(frames, dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768.0
    samples = samples.reshape(-1, channels)
    return samples, sample_rate


def _load_audio_array(
    source_path: str,
    sample_rate: int = DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE,
    channels: int = DEFAULT_CHANNELS,
) -> tuple["np.ndarray", int]:
    temporary_wav = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False)
    temporary_wav.close()
    try:
        _normalize_audio_to_wav(
            source_path=source_path,
            output_path=temporary_wav.name,
            sample_rate=sample_rate,
            channels=channels,
        )
        return _load_wav_array(temporary_wav.name)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary_wav.name):
            os.unlink(temporary_wav.name)

    section_gain_adjustments = {
        "intro": -0.04,
        "verse": 0.0,
        "pre_hook": 0.05,
        "hook": 0.11,
        "break": -0.08,
        "transition": 0.03,

    line_profile_section_emphasis = {

    line_profile_section_release = {
        ("dense_lyric", "verse"): -0.014,
        ("dense_lyric", "hook"): 0.006,
        ("emphatic_lyric", "hook"): 0.008,
        ("emphatic_lyric", "transition"): 0.004,

        ("non_lyric_event", "break"): 0.008,

    def _apply_gain_window(start_index: int, end_index: int, gain_db: float) -> None:
        start = max(0, int(start_index))
        end = min(total_samples, int(end_index))
        if end <= start:
            return
        gain_linear = float(10 ** (float(gain_db) / 20.0))
        envelope[start:end] *= gain_linear

    for bar_index, stage_name in stages.items():
        block_index = bar_to_block.get(int(bar_index))
        if block_index is None:
            block_index = bar_to_block.get(int(bar_index) - 1)
        block_profile = ""
        if block_index is not None and 0 <= block_index < len(blocks):
            block_profile = _clean_text(blocks[block_index].get("profile")).lower()
        gain_db = float(stage_gain_db.get(_clean_text(stage_name).lower(), 0.0))
        gain_db += float((profile_stage_adjustments.get(block_profile) or {}).get(_clean_text(stage_name).lower(), 0.0))
        section_type = _resolve_macrosection_type_for_bar(int(bar_index), macrosections)
        gain_db += float(section_gain_adjustments.get(section_type, 0.0))
        if gain_db == 0.0:
            continue
        start = int(bar_index * samples_per_bar)
        end = min(total_samples, start + samples_per_bar)
        _apply_gain_window(start, end, gain_db)

        for event in events:
            start_index = max(0, int(event.get("start_sample") or 0))
            end_index = min(total_samples, int(event.get("end_sample") or 0))
            if end_index <= start_index:
                continue
            pre_roll = max(32, int(round(0.01 * effective_sample_rate)))
            release = max(32, int(round(0.04 * effective_sample_rate)))

    smoothing_samples = max(64, int(round(0.03 * effective_sample_rate)))

    processed = np.clip(stereo * envelope[:, np.newaxis], -1.0, 1.0)

def _resolve_analysis_tempo(analysis_payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[float]:
    if not analysis_payload:
        return None
    analysis = analysis_payload.get("analysis") if "analysis" in analysis_payload else analysis_payload
    candidates = []
    for key in ("tempo_estimate_bpm_librosa", "tempo_estimate_bpm"):
        value = analysis.get(key)
        try:
            if value is not None:
                candidates.append(float(value))
        except Exception:
            continue
    if not candidates:
        return None
    return round(float(candidates[0]), 2)


def _resolve_analysis_key(analysis_payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if not analysis_payload:
        return {"key": None, "scale": None, "confidence": None}
    analysis = analysis_payload.get("analysis") if "analysis" in analysis_payload else analysis_payload
    return {
        "key": _clean_text(analysis.get("estimated_key")) or None,
        "scale": _clean_text(analysis.get("estimated_scale")) or None,
        "confidence": analysis.get("estimated_key_confidence"),
    }


def _key_distance_semitones(key_a: Optional[str], key_b: Optional[str]) -> Optional[int]:
    pitch_a = _key_name_to_pitch_class(key_a or "")
    pitch_b = _key_name_to_pitch_class(key_b or "")
    if pitch_a is None or pitch_b is None:
        return None
    raw_distance = abs(pitch_a - pitch_b)
    return min(raw_distance, 12 - raw_distance)

    if np is None:
        raise RuntimeError("NumPy nao esta disponivel no runtime atual.")
    if float(request.tempo_bpm) <= 0:

    run_dirs = _resolve_run_dir(project_id=request.project_id, run_id=request.run_id)
    bars = max(1, int(request.bars))
    steps_per_bar = max(1, int(request.steps_per_bar))
    total_steps = bars * steps_per_bar
    seconds_per_bar = 240.0 / float(request.tempo_bpm)
    seconds_per_step = seconds_per_bar / steps_per_bar
    swing = max(0.0, min(0.45, float(request.swing)))
    timing_jitter_ratio = max(0.0, min(0.45, float(request.timing_jitter_ratio or 0.0)))
    velocity_jitter_db = max(0.0, min(9.0, float(request.velocity_jitter_db or 0.0)))
    jitter_seed = (
        int(request.seed)
        if request.seed is not None
        else (zlib.crc32(f"{request.label}:{request.tempo_bpm}:{bars}:{steps_per_bar}".encode("utf-8")) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )
    rng = np.random.default_rng(jitter_seed)

    rendered_layers: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    longest_sample_length = 0
    prepared_layers = []
    for layer in request.layers:
        source_path = _resolve_existing_path(layer.audio_path)
        copied_input_path = _copy_into_directory(source_path, run_dirs["inputs_dir"])
        sample_array, sample_rate = _load_audio_array(
            source_path,
            sample_rate=int(request.sample_rate or DEFAULT_SAMPLE_RATE),
            channels=DEFAULT_CHANNELS,
        )
        processed_sample = _apply_gain_and_pan(sample_array, gain_db=layer.gain_db, pan=layer.pan)
        longest_sample_length = max(longest_sample_length, processed_sample.shape[0])
        prepared_layers.append(
            {
                "layer": layer,
                "source_path": source_path,
                "copied_input_path": copied_input_path,
                "sample_rate": sample_rate,
                "sample": processed_sample,
                "pattern": _parse_pattern(layer.pattern, bars=bars, steps_per_bar=steps_per_bar),
            }
        )

    base_total_samples = int(math.ceil((total_steps * seconds_per_step) * request.sample_rate))
    required_total_samples = base_total_samples
    for prepared in prepared_layers:
        pattern = prepared["pattern"]
        sample = prepared["sample"]
        active_steps = [index for index, is_active in enumerate(pattern) if is_active]
        if not active_steps:

        last_step_index = max(active_steps)
        last_start_seconds = last_step_index * seconds_per_step
        if swing > 0 and last_step_index % 2 == 1:
            last_start_seconds += seconds_per_step * swing * 0.5
        required_total_samples = max(
            required_total_samples,
            int(round(last_start_seconds * request.sample_rate)) + sample.shape[0],
        )

    total_samples = max(required_total_samples, base_total_samples)
    master = np.zeros((total_samples, 2), dtype=np.float32)

    for prepared in prepared_layers:
        layer = prepared["layer"]
        pattern = prepared["pattern"]
        sample = prepared["sample"]
        trigger_positions = []
        for step_index, active in enumerate(pattern):
            if not active:
                continue
            start_seconds = step_index * seconds_per_step
            if swing > 0 and step_index % 2 == 1:
                start_seconds += seconds_per_step * swing * 0.5
            timing_offset_seconds = 0.0
            if timing_jitter_ratio > 0:
                timing_offset_seconds = float(rng.uniform(-1.0, 1.0)) * seconds_per_step * timing_jitter_ratio
                start_seconds = max(0.0, start_seconds + timing_offset_seconds)
            start_index = int(round(start_seconds * request.sample_rate))
            triggered_sample = sample
            gain_offset_db = 0.0
            if velocity_jitter_db > 0:
                gain_offset_db = float(rng.uniform(-velocity_jitter_db, velocity_jitter_db))
                triggered_sample = sample * float(10 ** (gain_offset_db / 20.0))

            trigger_positions.append(
                {
                    "step_index": step_index,

                    "gain_offset_db": round(float(gain_offset_db), 4),
                }

        rendered_layers.append(

    if request.persist_to_project and request.project_id:

            project_id=request.project_id,
            label=request.label,
            artifact_path=output_path,
            source_run_id=run_dirs["run_id"],

            notes="Beat renderizado a partir de pads/padroes locais.",
            metadata={"session_type": "pattern_beat"},
        )

    manifest = {
        "request": request.to_dict(),
        "output_path": output_path,
        "rendered_layers": rendered_layers,

    manifest_path = os.path.join(run_dirs["manifests_dir"], "pattern_beat_manifest.json")
    _write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
    return manifest

payload.aggregated_output:
- The `vocal-fit` chain now also resolves an internal automatic mix profile, so space and glue can
  adapt as `tight`, `balanced`, or `open` behaviors without turning those controls into visible
  webapp parameters.
- `VocalFitRequest` can now also accept an optional high-level instrumental adaptation preference:
  `auto`, `dry`, `spaced`, `dense`, or `hook_support`. This is intended as a future creative UI
  option, not as a low-level technical control.
- The vocal-fit flow now also derives larger vocal macrosections such as `intro`, `verse`,
  `pre_hook`, `hook`, `break`, and `outro`, and uses them to steer the adapted instrumental
  arrangement across longer spans instead of only reacting bar-by-bar.
- Those macrosections now also feed phrase-energy, ducking, and vocal-space stages, so the mix can
  breathe differently in `verse`, `hook`, `break`, and `outro` without exposing new user-facing
  knobs.
- The same macrosection layer now also shapes arrangement transition accents and the final glue
  bus, so `break -> hook` and similar returns can feel more intentional in the finished mix.
- The vocal-side chain now also reacts to those macrosections: contextual clarity, phrase-level
  vocal automation, sibilance control, breath control, plosive control, and harshness control can
  all respond differently across `intro`, `verse`, `hook`, `break`, and `outro` without adding
  more webapp parameters.
- The adapted instrumental can now also pass through `macrosection_groove_automation` after the
  phrase-energy stage, adding subtle push/hold behavior by section so `hook`, `verse`, and
  `break` feel more intentional without changing the user-facing controls or forcing aggressive
  time-stretch.
- After that, the adapted instrumental can also receive `macrosection_harmonic_support`, which
  uses the detected vocal key as a tonal anchor and modulates light tonic/fifth reinforcement by
  macrosection so `hook`, `verse`, and `break` sit more naturally around the vocal's harmonic
  center.
- The vocal-fit chain can now also apply short `transition_space` passes to both the instrumental
  and the vocal, using macrosection borders and phrase releases to add controlled width/ambience
  around moments like `break -> hook` without turning the mix into a large reverb wash.
- After those transition-space passes, the vocal can also receive a dedicated
  `vocal_phrase_contrast` stage that adds subtle line-by-line dynamic emphasis for entries,
  important phrase regions, and selected hotspots without relying on a louder global vocal level.
- The `vocal-fit` flow now transcribes the user vocal by default whenever a compatible local
  `whisper.cpp` model is available, and it derives transcript-based line events from that result.
- The transcript parser now accepts both regular JSON payloads and the NDJSON-style one-object-per-
  line output emitted by the FFmpeg `whisper` filter, converting millisecond timestamps into
  seconds before building line events for downstream vocal-fit stages.
- Those transcript-derived line events now also feed a dedicated `transcript_line_support` pass on
  the instrumental side, so denser lyric lines can receive a little more space while line endings
  can breathe back into the beat more musically.
- The same line events now also steer short `transition_space` accents on both the instrumental and
  vocal paths, so line endings can help shape returns and transitions with more performance-aware
  timing.
- Transcript-derived line events are now also classified into lightweight internal profiles such as
  `dense_lyric`, `emphatic_lyric`, `adlib`, and `non_lyric_event`, so coughs, tags, and bracketed
  cues do not get treated like lead lyrical lines inside the vocal-fit chain.
- Those line profiles now also interact with macrosections, so a dense lyrical line in `hook` can
  trigger a different support/transition response than a dense line in `verse`, and non-lyric
  events can stay much more neutral.
- The vocal-aware arrangement builder now consumes those transcript line events before rerendering
  the adapted instrumental, so structural bar/step overrides can react to lyric density and
  non-lyric events instead of relying only on energy envelopes.
- The `macrosection_harmonic_support` stage now also consumes transcript line events, so harmonic
  reinforcement can stay lighter under dense lyrical lines in `verse`, return harder in `hook`, and
  remain more neutral around non-lyric events.
- The `macrosection_groove_automation` stage now also consumes transcript line events, so groove
  push/hold behavior can stay calmer under dense verse lines, return with more lift in hooks, and
  remain almost neutral around non-lyric events.
- The `phrase_energy_automation` stage now also consumes transcript line events, so dense lyrical
  passages can locally hold the beat in place while hook lines and returns can recover with more
  intention.
- The consolidated implementation roadmap lives in
  `docs/PHASE_7_MULTIMODAL_AUDIO_PLAN.md`.

does not need manual device parameters for this mode.
- `LoopbackCaptureRequest.reference_audio_mode` now distinguishes:
  - `instrumental`
  - `song_remove_vocals`
  When `song_remove_vocals` is used, the captured WAV is separated and the instrumental stem becomes
  the reference asset used for analysis and beat-blueprint generation.
- `render_blueprint_beat(...)` now turns the active project blueprint into an actual beat render:
  it synthesizes a minimal local kit (`kick`, `snare`, `hat`, and optional support `bass`), routes
  the result through the existing pattern renderer, and can optionally master the final WAV.
- `BlueprintBeatRenderRequest` now also supports:
  - `target_duration_seconds`
  - `creativity`
  - `fill_probability`
  - `timing_jitter_ratio`
  - `velocity_jitter_db`
  so the active blueprint can render into a longer arrangement with section-aware variation
  and controlled humanization instead of a short static loop.
- The same autorender path now synthesizes phrase tracks for `bass` and `melody`:
  a moving bassline and a lightweight melodic motif are derived from the reference pitch context
  when the blueprint does not already provide richer melodic layers.
- The autorender can also derive a low-level `texture` layer from the promoted reference audio,
  using a filtered loop taken from the source so the final beat is less purely synthetic.
- The same path can now derive a rhythmic `chop` layer from the promoted reference and route the
  rendered beat through a lightweight `creative mix` bus before optional mastering.
- `fit_vocal_to_beat(...)` now handles the first `vocal-fit` workflow for user-provided vocal files:
  it analyzes the beat and vocal, produces a fit plan, prepares the vocal, ducks the instrumental,
  renders the combined mix, and can optionally master the result.
- In `vocal-fit`, the vocal is now treated as the master timeline:
  when the instrumental is shorter, the active blueprint can be re-rendered to cover the vocal
  duration, and the ducking stage responds to vocal activity instead of applying a single global
  sidechain setting.
- When the beat is re-rendered for `vocal-fit`, the rerender can now anchor its pitch context to
  the vocal key/scale so the adapted instrumental starts closer to the harmonic center of the
  user-provided voice before the final mix.
- When the beat is re-rendered for `vocal-fit`, the pipeline can also produce a `vocal-aware`
  arrangement pass that reduces selected layers by role and only mutes texture-like elements on
  bars with stronger vocal activity
  before the final ducking and mix stage.
- The `vocal-aware` pass now also reacts at step-level resolution, so dense vocal phrases can
  locally soften hats/melody/chops without flattening the entire bar.

def _build_phrase_note_events(
    role: str,
    sections: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    tempo_bpm: float,
    steps_per_bar: int,
    pitch_context: Dict[str, Any],
    creativity: float,
    seed: int,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    resolved_role = (_clean_text(role) or "melody").lower()
    scale_intervals = list(pitch_context["scale_intervals"])
    bass_root = int(pitch_context["bass_root_midi"])
    melody_root = int(pitch_context["melody_root_midi"])
    section_progressions = dict(pitch_context.get("section_progressions") or {})
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    seconds_per_bar = 240.0 / float(tempo_bpm)
    step_seconds = seconds_per_bar / float(steps_per_bar)

    bass_walk_degrees = [0, 2, 4, 3, 0, 5, 4, 2]
    motif_steps = [0, 3, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14]
    events: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    current_bar_start = 0.0

    for section_index, section in enumerate(sections):
        section_name = _clean_text(section.get("name")) or f"section_{section_index + 1}"
        bars = max(1, int(section.get("bars") or 1))
        progression = list(section_progressions.get(section_name) or section_progressions.get("main_a") or [0])
        bass_density = float(section.get("bass_density") or 1.0)
        melodic_density = float(section.get("melodic_density") or 1.0)

        for bar_index in range(bars):
            progression_degree = int(progression[bar_index % len(progression)]) if progression else 0
            progression_offset = scale_intervals[progression_degree % len(scale_intervals)]
            if resolved_role == "bass":
                step_candidates = {
                    "intro": [0],
                    "main_a": [0, 8],
                    "fill": [0, 6, 10, 12],
                    "main_b": [0, 4, 8, 12],
                    "break": [0],
                    "main_c": [0, 4, 8, 11, 14],
                    "outro": [0],
                }.get(section_name, [0, 8])
                for event_index, step in enumerate(step_candidates):
                    degree = bass_walk_degrees[(bar_index + event_index) % len(bass_walk_degrees)]
                    midi_note = bass_root + progression_offset + scale_intervals[degree % len(scale_intervals)]
                    if section_name == "fill" and event_index >= 2:
                        midi_note += 12
                    if section_name == "main_b" and event_index == len(step_candidates) - 1 and rng.random() < 0.45:
                        midi_note += 12
                    if section_name == "main_c" and event_index in {1, 3} and rng.random() < 0.42:
                        midi_note += 12
                    duration_steps = 5 if step == 0 else 3 if section_name != "main_b" else 2
                    if section_name == "main_c" and step != 0:
                        duration_steps = 2
                    amplitude = (0.46 if step == 0 else 0.34) * bass_density
                    if rng.random() < creativity * 0.22:
                        midi_note += 12 if rng.random() < 0.25 else 0
                    events.append(
                        {
                            "start_seconds": round(float(current_bar_start + (step * step_seconds)), 4),
                            "duration_seconds": round(float(duration_steps * step_seconds), 4),
                            "frequency_hz": round(_midi_to_frequency(midi_note), 3),
                            "amplitude": round(float(amplitude), 4),
                            "midi_note": int(midi_note),
                            "section_name": section_name,
                        }
                    )
            else:
                active_steps = {
                    "intro": [8, 12],
                    "main_a": [0, 4, 8, 12],
                    "fill": [8, 10, 12, 14],
                    "main_b": [0, 3, 6, 8, 11, 14],
                    "break": [10],
                    "main_c": [0, 2, 4, 7, 9, 12, 14],
                    "outro": [0, 6],
                }.get(section_name, [0, 4, 8, 12])
                motif_pool = {
                    "intro": [0, 2, 4, 2, 0, 4],
                    "main_a": [0, 2, 4, 2, 0, 5, 4, 2],
                    "fill": [4, 5, 6, 5, 4, 2],
                    "main_b": [0, 4, 5, 7, 4, 2, 5, 4],
                    "break": [4, 2, 0],

Agora, em [audio_pipeline.py](C:/Users/acaci/Documents/scoreIA/ScoreIA/tools/audio_gen/audio_pipeline.py), a geração de `bass` e `melody` ficou mais consciente de frase:
- entradas, fills, breaks e retornos agora mudam escolhas de passos, duração e contorno;
- os ranges foram contidos para evitar saltos exagerados, especialmente no bass;
- isso ajuda `main_a`, `main_b` e transições a soarem menos como a mesma frase reaproveitada.

Validei com smoke real:
- output: [instrumental-phrasing-range-smoke_creative_mix.wav](C:/Users/acaci/Documents/scoreIA/ScoreIA/artifacts/audio_gen/phase7-e2e-20260414/run_20260414223920/mixes/instrumental-phrasing-range-smoke_creative_mix.wav)
- manifesto: [blueprint_render_manifest.json](C:/Users/acaci/Documents/scoreIA/ScoreIA/artifacts/audio_gen/phase7-e2e-20260414/run_20260414223920/manifests/blueprint_render_manifest.json)

Também atualizei:
- [README.md](C:/Users/acaci/Documents/scoreIA/ScoreIA/tools/audio_gen/README.md)
- [PHASE_7_MULTIMODAL_AUDIO_PLAN.md](C:/Users/acaci/Documents/scoreIA/ScoreIA/docs/PHASE_7_MULTIMODAL_AUDIO_PLAN.md)

Leitura prática do avanço:
- o low-end já respira melhor por causa do `kick_bass_sidechain`;
- as seções já contrastam mais;
- e agora o conteúdo melódico/harmônico está menos “reto” e menos propenso a notas fora de faixa.

O próximo salto mais valioso agora é atacar a **qualidade tímbrica do motivo melódico e dos chops**, para o beat ficar menos “síntese funcional” e mais “produção com identidade”.

def _add_synth_note(
    buffer: "np.ndarray",
    sample_rate: int,
    start_seconds: float,
    duration_seconds: float,
    frequency_hz: float,
    amplitude: float,
    role: str,
) -> None:
    if np is None:
        raise RuntimeError("NumPy nao esta disponivel no runtime atual.")
    start_index = int(round(max(0.0, start_seconds) * sample_rate))
    length = max(32, int(round(max(0.03, duration_seconds) * sample_rate)))
    end_index = min(buffer.shape[0], start_index + length)
    if end_index <= start_index:
        return

    t = np.arange(end_index - start_index, dtype=np.float32) / float(sample_rate)
    role_name = (_clean_text(role) or "melody").lower()
    if role_name == "bass":
        body = np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * t)
        overtone = 0.24 * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * 2.0 * t + 0.25)
        grit = 0.08 * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * 3.0 * t + 0.18)
        signal_mono = np.tanh((body + overtone + grit) * 1.18)
        attack = 0.008
        release = 0.18
    else:
        body = np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * t)
        shimmer = 0.22 * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * 2.0 * t)
        air = 0.1 * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * 3.0 * t + 0.4)
        body2 = 0.06 * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * frequency_hz * 4.0 * t + 0.2)
        signal_mono = np.tanh((body + shimmer + air + body2) * 1.1)
        attack = 0.015
        release = 0.16

    env = np.ones_like(t, dtype=np.float32)
    attack_len = min(len(env), max(1, int(round(attack * sample_rate))))
    env[:attack_len] *= np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, attack_len, dtype=np.float32)
    release_len = min(len(env), max(1, int(round(release * sample_rate))))
    env[-release_len:] *= np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, release_len, dtype=np.float32)
    sustain_curve = np.exp(-t * (2.4 if role_name == "bass" else 3.25))
    mono = signal_mono * env * sustain_curve * float(amplitude)
    stereo = _stereo_from_mono(mono)
    buffer[start_index:end_index] += stereo[: end_index - start_index]

def _build_single_trigger_pattern(total_bars: int, steps_per_bar: int) -> str:
    total_steps = max(1, int(total_bars)) * max(1, int(steps_per_bar))
    return "x" + ("-" * max(0, total_steps - 1))


def _extract_reference_texture_track(
    reference_path: str,
    output_path: str,
    sample_rate: int,
    tempo_bpm: float,
    total_bars: int,
    sections: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
    style_tags: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if np is None:
        raise RuntimeError("NumPy nao esta disponivel no runtime atual.")

    source_path = _resolve_existing_path(reference_path)
    source_audio, _ = _load_audio_array(source_path, sample_rate=sample_rate, channels=DEFAULT_CHANNELS)
    stereo = _ensure_stereo(source_audio)
    total_seconds = (240.0 / float(tempo_bpm)) * max(1, int(total_bars))
    total_samples = max(64, int(math.ceil(total_seconds * sample_rate)))
    seconds_per_bar = 240.0 / float(tempo_bpm)
    segment_seconds = min(max(seconds_per_bar, 1.4), 3.0)
    segment_length = min(stereo.shape[0], max(2048, int(round(segment_seconds * sample_rate))))

    secondary_start = 0
    secondary_segment = None
    if stereo.shape[0] <= segment_length:
        segment = stereo.copy()
        chosen_start = 0
        secondary_segment = np.flip(segment, axis=0).copy()
    else:
        start_min = int(stereo.shape[0] * 0.15)
        start_max = max(start_min + 1, int(stereo.shape[0] * 0.7))
        step = max(512, segment_length // 3)
        ranked_candidates: List[tuple[float, int]] = []
        chosen_start = start_min
        for start in range(start_min, min(start_max, stereo.shape[0] - segment_length), step):
            window = stereo[start : start + segment_length]
            mono = window.mean(axis=1)
            rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono * mono) + 1e-12))
            if rms < 0.01:
                continue
            brightness = float(np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(mono)))) if mono.size > 1 else 0.0
            score = (rms * 0.8) + (brightness * 0.2)
            ranked_candidates.append((score, start))
        if ranked_candidates:
            ranked_candidates.sort(key=lambda item: item[0], reverse=True)
            chosen_start = ranked_candidates[0][1]
            secondary_start = ranked_candidates[1][1] if len(ranked_candidates) > 1 else ranked_candidates[0][1]
        segment = stereo[chosen_start : chosen_start + segment_length].copy()
        secondary_segment = stereo[secondary_start : secondary_start + segment_length].copy()

    if signal is not None and segment.shape[0] > 128:
        style_tokens = {token.lower() for token in _normalize_str_list(style_tags)}
        lowpass_hz = 4200.0 if "dark" in style_tokens else 6200.0
        try:
            hp_b, hp_a = signal.butter(2, 180.0 / (sample_rate * 0.5), btype="highpass")
            lp_b, lp_a = signal.butter(2, lowpass_hz / (sample_rate * 0.5), btype="lowpass")
            for channel in range(segment.shape[1]):
                filtered = signal.filtfilt(hp_b, hp_a, segment[:, channel]).astype(np.float32)
                filtered = signal.filtfilt(lp_b, lp_a, filtered).astype(np.float32)
                segment[:, channel] = filtered
                if secondary_segment is not None and secondary_segment.shape[0] > 0:
                    filtered_alt = signal.filtfilt(hp_b, hp_a, secondary_segment[:, channel]).astype(np.float32)
                    filtered_alt = signal.filtfilt(lp_b, lp_a, filtered_alt).astype(np.float32)
                    secondary_segment[:, channel] = filtered_alt
        except Exception:
            pass

    fade_samples = min(max(64, int(round(sample_rate * 0.03))), max(1, segment.shape[0] // 8))
    fade_in = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, fade_samples, dtype=np.float32)
    fade_out = np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, fade_samples, dtype=np.float32)
    segment[:fade_samples] *= fade_in[:, np.newaxis]
    segment[-fade_samples:] *= fade_out[:, np.newaxis]
    if secondary_segment is not None and secondary_segment.shape[0] > 0:
        secondary_segment[:fade_samples] *= fade_in[:, np.newaxis]
        secondary_segment[-fade_samples:] *= fade_out[:, np.newaxis]

    resolved_sections = list(sections or [])
    if not resolved_sections:
        resolved_sections = [{"name": "main_a", "bars": max(1, int(total_bars)), "energy": 0.92}]
    section_buffers: List["np.ndarray"] = []
    seconds_per_bar = 240.0 / float(tempo_bpm)
    for section_index, section in enumerate(resolved_sections):
        section_name = _clean_text(section.get("name")).lower() or f"section_{section_index + 1}"
        bars = max(1, int(section.get("bars") or 1))
        section_seconds = seconds_per_bar * bars
        section_samples = max(64, int(round(section_seconds * sample_rate)))
        if section_name == "break":
            base_segment = np.flip(segment, axis=0).copy()
        elif section_name in {"main_b", "main_c"} and secondary_segment is not None:
            base_segment = secondary_segment.copy()
        else:
            base_segment = segment.copy()
        repeats = int(math.ceil(section_samples / max(1, base_segment.shape[0])))
        section_audio = np.tile(base_segment, (repeats, 1))[:section_samples]
        section_gain = {
            "intro": 0.26,
            "main_a": 0.32,
            "fill": 0.24,
            "main_b": 0.36,
            "break": 0.18,
            "main_c": 0.38,
            "outro": 0.22,
        }.get(section_name, 0.32)
        width_gain = {
            "intro": 0.08,
            "main_a": 0.12,
            "fill": 0.1,
            "main_b": 0.18,
            "break": 0.05,
            "main_c": 0.22,
            "outro": 0.08,
        }.get(section_name, 0.12)
        mid = ((section_audio[:, 0] + section_audio[:, 1]) * 0.5).astype(np.float32)
        side = ((section_audio[:, 0] - section_audio[:, 1]) * 0.5).astype(np.float32)
        side *= (1.0 + width_gain)
        section_audio = np.stack([mid + side, mid - side], axis=1).astype(np.float32)
        section_audio *= float(section_gain)
        if section_index > 0:
            crossfade = min(max(128, int(round(sample_rate * 0.045))), section_audio.shape[0] // 4, section_buffers[-1].shape[0] // 4)
            if crossfade > 0:
                fade_prev = np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, crossfade, dtype=np.float32)[:, np.newaxis]
                fade_next = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, crossfade, dtype=np.float32)[:, np.newaxis]
                section_buffers[-1][-crossfade:] *= fade_prev
                section_audio[:crossfade] *= fade_next
        section_buffers.append(section_audio)

    tiled = np.concatenate(section_buffers, axis=0)[:total_samples]
    tiled = _normalize_audio_buffer(tiled, peak=0.35)

    sample_rate: int,

    bass_layer_names: List[str] = []
    for layer_manifest in rendered_layers:
        role_name = _clean_text(layer_manifest.get("role")).lower()
        if role_name == "kick":
            kick_events.extend(list(layer_manifest.get("trigger_positions") or []))

def create_reference_beat_blueprint(request: BeatBlueprintRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    ensure_runtime_ready("analysis")
    if not request.reference_audio_paths:
        raise ValueError("Informe pelo menos um audio de referencia para montar o blueprint.")

    run_dirs = _resolve_run_dir(project_id=request.project_id, run_id=request.run_id)
    reference_summaries: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    tempos: List[float] = []
    inferred_roles: List[str] = []
    collected_moods: List[str] = []
    external_reference_context = _build_external_reference_context(
        request.project_id,
        request.source_reference_ids,
    )
    tempos.extend(external_reference_context["tempos"])

    for reference_path in request.reference_audio_paths:
        source_path = _resolve_existing_path(reference_path)
        samples, sample_rate = _load_audio_array(source_path, sample_rate=22050, channels=2)
        descriptors = _compute_audio_descriptors(samples, sample_rate)
        librosa_descriptors = _compute_librosa_descriptors(source_path, sample_rate=22050)
        if librosa_descriptors:
            descriptors.update(librosa_descriptors)
            if descriptors.get("tempo_estimate_bpm") is None and librosa_descriptors.get("tempo_estimate_bpm_librosa") is not None:
                descriptors["tempo_estimate_bpm"] = librosa_descriptors.get("tempo_estimate_bpm_librosa")
        role = _infer_reference_role_from_path(source_path)
        inferred_roles.append(role)
        if descriptors.get("tempo_estimate_bpm") is not None:
            tempos.append(float(descriptors["tempo_estimate_bpm"]))
        collected_moods.extend(descriptors.get("mood_tags") or [])
        reference_summaries.append(
            {
                "path": source_path,
                "role": role,
                "analysis": descriptors,
            }
        )

    target_bpm = float(request.target_bpm) if request.target_bpm is not None else (

+            continue

+        width_gain = float(section_width_map.get(section_name, 0.0))
+        body_gain = float(section_body_map.get(section_name, 0.0))
+        gain_db_envelope[start_index:end_index] += gain_db
+        width_envelope[start_index:end_index] += width_gain
+        body_envelope[start_index:end_index] += body_gain
+        events.append(
+            {
+                "section_name": section_name,
+                "bars": int(bars),
+                "gain_db": round(gain_db, 4),
+                "width_gain": round(width_gain, 4),
+                "body_gain": round(body_gain, 4),
+            }
+        )
+        current_bar += bars
+
